episode_summary: In this episode, Chris Linsell discusses the importance of building a personal brand independent of brokerage identity, especially in light of recent real estate mergers. He emphasizes the need for agents to focus on AI visibility through content creation and citation density. The episode also explores the potential resurgence of indie brokerages as a response to industry consolidation.
